_about: Gathering (scripts/camp/camp_gather.gd). Each choppable scenery tree (models in trees.models) gives wood_per_tree wood, one per chop, then falls: a stump (stump_model) stays and a sapling (sapling_item, drawn as sapling_model) drops beside it at sapling_offset [x, z] metres. A sapling planted at a bare stump grows back into the tree after grow_days mornings. A chop takes chop_s while the tree wobbles (wobble_deg, wobble_s); a player works within reach_m of a tree's trunk. Forage spots refill each morning: each has an item, a model drawn while it is there, a spot [x, z] in metres and from_day (a day number) it first appears. A stick goes straight onto the camp's wood pile (wood item); others go into the pockets. Grilling uses cook_wood wood from the pile. long_log: each morning while the camp has none, a long log (model, carried like a chair) lies at pos [x, z] turned yaw degrees. Carried alone it goes at alone_speed of walking pace; with the other player within help_m it goes at full pace. Set down within fire_m of a fire_model in the clearing it splits into wood on the pile.
